# Stake Solana — Stake SOL (Native Delegation & Liquid Staking) Reference

> Earn SOL staking rewards on Solana via native delegation to a validator or liquid staking (jitoSOL, mSOL). Rewards come from Solana inflation minus commission; epochs bring warm-up and cool-down. Non-custodial. Independent, not affiliated with Solana.

## Key Facts
- Two paths: native staking (delegate SOL to a validator; SOL stays in a stake account under your keys) and liquid staking (deposit SOL, receive a liquid staking token such as jitoSOL or mSOL that stays usable in DeFi)
- Rewards: from Solana's staking inflation minus validator/protocol commission; amounts vary (no fixed rate)
- Epochs: newly delegated stake warms up before it is fully active; deactivating native stake cools down over an epoch boundary before SOL is withdrawable
- Liquid staking exit: redeem or swap the receipt token, subject to available liquidity
- Custody: non-custodial — native stake accounts remain under your keys; liquid staking uses public smart contracts your wallet signs
- Risks: slashing/penalty risk for validator faults, smart-contract risk (liquid staking programs), de-peg risk of the liquid staking token vs SOL, illiquidity during cool-down; returns never guaranteed
- Independent resource — NOT affiliated with or endorsed by Solana or the Solana Foundation
